hotels.title: Central Townsville Escape near The Strand with Onsite Restaurant
hotels.description: Step into sunny North Queensland ease at Holiday Inn Townsville, a central Flinders Street stay made for city exploring, stadium nights and island day trips. You’re in the heart of the CBD, close to the dining precinct, Queensland Country Bank Stadium and the ferry to Yunbenun (Magnetic Island). Mornings can start with made-to-order breakfast and quality coffee at Bistro Sol before you wander The Strand waterfront promenade, or set out to snorkel the Great Barrier Reef. Return to spacious, thoughtfully designed rooms, keep your routine on track in the fitness centre and let Holiday Inn’s easygoing service make business trips, weekends away and family stays feel smooth from start to finish.

hotels.title: Lush Tropical Leisure at Mercure Townsville Resort
hotels.description: Comfort and convenience go hand-in-hand on the lush resort grounds of Mercure Townsville, just minutes away from the airport and the heart of town. Whether you’re swimming the Great Barrier Reef or walking the sandy stretches of Townsville’s spectacular beaches, you can return to your verdant haven and unwind after long days spent exploring Tropical North Queensland. Savour hearty al fresco dining at poolside Celsius Restaurant and Bar, using fresh local produce to bring their culinary vision to life. With spacious rooms featuring light and airy design, Townsville’s largest freeform pool and outdoor spa, your time at Mercure Townsville is sure to impress.
